description: This PHP source file defines a helper class 'file' that provides static methods for file handling operations such as MIME type detection, extension extraction, writability check, and filename management within the KCFinder project.

classes.name: file
classes.description: A helper class providing static methods for file operations such as MIME type retrieval, extension extraction, writable checks, and generating non-conflicting filenames.

methods.name: isWritable
methods.description: Checks if the given file is writable, handling Windows server peculiarities.

methods.name: getExtension
methods.description: Retrieves the file extension from a filename, optionally converting to lowercase.

methods.name: getMimeType
methods.description: Determines the MIME type of a file, using either the file content via PHP's finfo extension or falling back to extension-based MIME mapping.

methods.name: getInexistantFilename
methods.description: Generates a filename that does not exist in the target directory by appending a suffix if needed.
